thesis: The speaker argues that intense singular focus on a singular goal transforms limited preparation time into unlimited opportunity, as demonstrated by an alum who mentally solved physics problems during physical training and wrote JEE papers twice daily for two months without coaching. Additionally, the speaker advises overcoming stage fright by participating in school dramas, joining Toastmasters, and viewing public speaking as a vital skill for various adult roles.
